ablation_description: Full Proposed HF-STFloodNet (27 features + Stacking + Attention + Uncertainty)
w/o Tabular Gradient Boosting Branch (ST-FloodNet Standalone)
w/o Latent Deep Representation (Stacking on Probabilities Only)
w/o Temporal Attention (Uniform Average Recurrent Pooling)
w/o Bidirectional GRU Memory (Pure Convolutional Antecedent Branch)
w/o Sentinel-1 SAR Radar Modality (Zeroed VV, VH, Cross-ratio)
w/o Sentinel-2 Optical Spectral Modality (Zeroed NDWI, NDVI)
w/o Topographic Geomorphology (Zeroed Elevation, Slope, River Dist, TWI)
w/o Socioeconomic Exposure Modality (Zeroed Population, Vulnerability)
